info.name: Byruha API v1
info.description: Postman documentation for the Byruha mobile API. The collection is intended for the Flutter developer and covers every current v1 endpoint, request body, path/query parameters, and response examples. All endpoints are under /api/v1 and currently use no authentication middleware.

item.name: Customers
item.description: CRUD endpoints for customers. The API requires phone_number for create and update, even though email is optional.

query.description: Optional. Integer from 1 to 100. Defaults to 15.

request.description: Returns a paginated list of customers ordered by latest created.
Creates a customer. Required fields: name, phone_number, password, password_confirmation. Optional: email. Omani local phone numbers are normalized to +968 format.

response.name: 422 Validation error

request.description: Returns one customer by numeric ID.
Updates a customer. phone_number is required. name, email, and password are optional when using PATCH. Include password_confirmation when updating password.

response.name: 422 Validation error

request.description: Deletes a customer by numeric ID. Related family members and bookings cascade through database constraints.

item.name: Customer Bookings

query.description: Optional. Integer from 1 to 100. Defaults to 15.

request.description: Returns paginated bookings owned by the customer.
